cmd:
cd /opt/weather-pipeline/repo
echo "=== .git depth1 ==="; du -h --max-depth=1 .git | sort -rh | head
echo "=== .git/objects depth1 ==="; du -h --max-depth=1 .git/objects | sort -rh | head -8
echo "=== count-objects ==="; git count-objects -vH
echo "=== packs ==="; ls -laSh .git/objects/pack | head -12
echo "=== shallow lines ==="; wc -l .git/shallow 2>/dev/null
echo "=== rev-list count ==="; git rev-list --count HEAD
echo "=== refs ==="; git for-each-ref | wc -l; git branch -a | head
echo "=== reflog ==="; git reflog | wc -l
echo "=== gc.log / tmp packs ==="; ls -la .git/gc.log 2>/dev/null; ls -la .git/objects/pack/tmp_* 2>/dev/null | head
echo "=== config ==="; git config --get-regexp 'gc|fetch|pack' 
echo "=== .git mtime ==="; stat -c '%y' .git/objects/pack/* | sort | tail -3
git log -1 --format='%H %cd'
